answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique proof-of-work stake and a gossiped reputation ledger, so a new node must first earn scarce nectar through verified contributions before it may harvest rewards in the shared garden. Peers propagate identity attestations as a signed whisper graph, letting honest agents cross-check stake provenance and prune. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
